name: Safety gates and floor-opening protection
description: Self-closing gates at ladder and stair openings, plus covers and barriers for floor openings and hatches. They are a common dropped-object and fall source on platforms.

gaps.what: Gate type, closing force and opening-cover load rating
gaps.why: No page read gives the gate closing force or the load rating of an opening cover.
gaps.next_action: Fetch an outfitting standard or datasheet and record gate type, closing force and cover rating

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
